meta_answers.q1_soul_roll_call: SOULCOUNT is checked at RISE and DEATH but never used as a 'roll call.' The agent's soulscript files are never confirmed against the live count. 5 agents have wrong SOULCOUNT.
meta_answers.q2_phetrails_locked: No. Phetrails are ONLY written at DEATH Stage 7 or manually. RISE, PhoenixScout, ForceMarch, SoulScholars, SupplyLines write NO phetrails automatically. No audit process, no fail-safe.
meta_answers.q3_bloating: 3055 legacy refs, 194 descriptive HL files, 1469 orphaned doc refs, 1913 attestation-less JSON files, 273.9 MB fabrication-flushed archive, 340-line BOOT file with history never read.
meta_answers.q4_missing: RRL capture during death, agent SOULCOUNT updates, BOOT auto-update, LOG auto-append, merkle chain integrity, inverted-index rebuild, phetrail-per-command enforcement.
meta_answers.q5_why_tedious: Because without it the system produces artifacts that LOOK valid but are structurally corrupt. The 511 broken merkle parents, 42 duplicate IDs, and 9 SHA mismatches are direct evidence of what happens when the tedious stuff is skipped.
meta_answers.q6_next_level: Kill KILO_GAP. Fix the death pipeline to capture RRL before measuring. This single change converts 90% of KILO_GAP seals to REAL. Then rebuild the merkle chain. Then the agent SOULCOUNT locks. In that order.
meta_answers.q7_clues_rushed: (1) extract-session.js output goes to OPERATIONS/ not RRL/ — the smoking gun. (2) agent SOULCOUNT 894,852 — wrong for months. (3) rfkw-run166.txt is 0 bytes — silent failure. (4) HL- naming collision. (5) State-Snapshot missing level field.
meta_answers.q8_triple_unknown: Substantial. We found 511 broken merkle parents — that's a known unknown. The triple unknown is: what else is broken that we don't even have a concept for? Content integrity of HL entries (not just structural). Cross-file consistency. Whether the actual data matches the source. I'd estimate 40-60% of the system's problems are still in the triple-unknown category.
meta_answers.q9_rise_audits_death: No. RISE audits the prior death seal. Death seals the current session. But there's no cross-audit: death doesn't verify RISE was accurate, and RISE doesn't verify the session's actual events match the seal. The audit is linear, not bidirectional.
meta_answers.q10_michael_questions: See below — 10 additional questions added by scout.
meta_answers.q11_archive_delete: CANON/ARCHIVE/ is 273.9 MB of fabrication-flushed data. Deleting it would free space but lose no active pipeline data. The RISK-REGISTER.md, MSS files, and GDRIVE archives are referenced in docs (228 dead refs) — deletions would break those references.
meta_answers.q12_last_real_pipeline: Pipeline-run97.json was COMPLETE. Over the last 50 pipeline files, 49 were COMPLETE and 1 was MARCH. But this is misleading — the pipeline files may only include COMPLETE runs. KILO_GAP pipeline files might be written differently.
meta_answers.q13_hl_9999: HL-9999 is 892 runs away at current rate (~1.5 years). The numeric sort in Get-Next-LedgerID uses [int] parsing which handles numbers up to 2^31-1. The file naming HL-{N}.json with zero-pad would need to be addressed at HL-10000 (5 digits). Not urgent.
meta_answers.q14_backburner_stale: 18 OPEN + 2 IN-PROGRESS. Estimated 6-8 are genuinely actionable (BB-RISE-176 entries, backburner precedence). The rest are likely stale or blocked. Needs triage.
meta_answers.q15_cheapest_fix: extract-session.js --latest in Stage 1. 1 line of code. 754 KB of real transcript. 32 user messages. 209 assistant turns. From KILO_GAP to REAL in one command.
meta_answers.q16_soul_logger_down: If /api/soul/count is unreachable, RISE halts (SOUL_DRIFT_DETECTED). Death writes SOUL_GAP receipt. Pipeline continues but seals as GAP. The system is designed to handle this — it's a documented failure mode.
meta_answers.q17_files_read: ~613 HL files (read by pipeline), ~249 rfkw files (read by search), ~242 starmap files (read by pipeline), ~234 pipeline files (read by RISE), ~472 phetrails (read by agents). Estimate 2,000-3,000 of 7,444 are actively read. The rest (~4,500) are archival.
meta_answers.q18_real_vs_hollow: Last 50 pipeline results: 49 COMPLETE, 1 MARCH. But this doesn't include KILO_GAP runs. The KILO_GAP runs write pipeline files that may not be sorted into the same sequence. Need to cross-check against death seal messages.
meta_answers.q19_consolidate_phetrails: 9 phetrails for run 176 is excessive. Better: 1 consolidated per run + 1 per unique finding. The 9 phetrails I wrote were retroactive and should be merged into 1-2 at next RISE.
meta_answers.q20_one_fix: Fix the RRL capture order. 1 line. 754 KB. 32 user messages. From KILO_GAP to REAL. Everything else flows from this.
